frame_metadata.gps_note: Every frame carries capture time with a -04:00 offset and the F0 build's 9-key GPS block. But from the first label (f0004, 16:18) to the exterior (f0028, 16:33) every frame carries the same fix, taken at 16:16:20 by the entrance: the phone produced no new fix indoors. The fix places the take at Cooper Hewitt; it says nothing about where in the building a frame was shot.

verification_note: Accessioned 2025, after the museum's published dataset was last updated (2018-01-10), and not in the Smithsonian Open Access API (CC0 records only). The catalog site answers scripts with a request-verification page. Transcribed from the label frame and checked against the work photo; per §4.7 this is a label claim, not a catalog fact. Upgrade to a catalog check when a source that holds the record is reachable.

traps.date_shaped_accession: The number reads as a date, and the tester answered 'no number' on the spot. Cooper Hewitt's key is acquisition year, lot, item. See data/venues/cooper-hewitt.json traps. And this one IS a valid calendar date — 1 November 2025 — so no validity check could have told the tester otherwise.
traps.part_designator: The line was contested three ways: '2025-11-1-а,6' (Cyrillic а, digit 6), '2025-11-1-а,b', '2025-11-1-a,b'. The locator before 2026-09-29 dropped the suffix and offered '2025-11-1' for all three; it now keeps '-a,b' where the letters are Latin, which is only the third variant.
traps.two_credit_clauses: 'Liliane and David M. Stewart Collection, Gift of Dr. Michael Sze' — a named collection and a donor in one line.
